title: 第738章 身死脊梁第737章 法相内蕴天人之限
lines: 陆沉那一拳砸落，手感却有些空。
不像是砸在血肉之躯上的沉闷，倒像一拳砸进了水里，力量被卸去了大半。
烟尘散去，那片被轰得塌陷的山崖上只剩碎石和焦土，安立渊的身影已经不见了。
陆沉收回拳头，目光扫过那片废墟，眉头微微拧起。
他确信自己那一拳是打中了的。
天地之力在那瞬间将安立渊锁死在原地，以他阴阳境巅峰的修为，根本不可能挣脱。
可对方确实逃了，用了一种连他都未曾见过的秘法，在拳劲及体的那一瞬间将大部分力量转移到了别处，只付出一只手臂的代价便从必死的局面中脱身而出。
安家能在安崖府屹立数百年，确实有几分底蕴。
不过，也仅此而已了。
陆沉闭上眼，将心神沉入天地之间。
生死真意如潮水般向四面八方扩散，方圆数十里的天地之力都在他的感知中纤毫毕现。
他捕捉到了那道正在急速远去的微弱气息。
安立渊的气息比全盛时弱了七成。
可那微弱的气息中带着一股熟悉的血腥，那是安家秘法燃烧精血后特有的余韵。
陆沉睁开眼，嘴角微微上扬。
像猎人嗅到了猎物伤口上血腥味。
他一步踏出，身形骤然消失在原地。
安立渊在疯狂地逃。
他的右臂齐肩而断，鲜血从断口处喷涌而出，将青布长袍浸透成一片深褐。
他用左臂捂着伤口，脚下不敢有片刻停留，每一步踏在虚空中都荡开一圈血色的涟漪。
这正是安家的秘法，血遁术！
以燃烧精血为代价换取的急速，每一息都在消耗他为数不多的寿元。
可他顾不上了，再不跑，命都没了！
他心中满是后悔。
若是知道陆沉在刚突破宗师时便已经渡过了天人之限，他绝不会选在这个时候动手，更不会亲自出手！
天人之限，那是宗师境界内的一道天堑，是通往武圣之路的一道门槛！
绝大多数宗师终其一生都摸不到它的边，走上天人之限，需要面对的是自己的生死！
没有人知道自己会遇到什么情况。
也没有人知道他能不能跨的过去。
这也正是宗师多，而能够成就武圣之人凤毛麟角的缘故！
天人之限虽然是一道门槛，但对武人而言，也是质变！
阴阳境加天人之限，直接对标法相！
他一个阴阳境巅峰，去对标一个法相境，怎么打？
他心中暗恨，这小贼明明拥有这等实力，偏偏藏拙，在他根本没有防备的时候才突然下死手。
content_en:
Lu Chen's punch landed, but it felt a little empty.
It's not like a punch hitting a flesh and blood body, but like a punch hitting water, and most of the power has been removed.
When the smoke and dust dispersed, only gravel and scorched earth remained on the collapsed cliff, and An Liyuan's figure had disappeared.
Lu Chen retracted his fist, glanced over the ruins, and frowned slightly.
He was sure that his punch was a hit.
The power of heaven and earth locked An Liyuan in place at that moment. With his cultivation at the peak of the Yin and Yang realm, it was impossible for him to break free.
But the opponent did escape, using a secret method that even he had never seen before, transferring most of the power to other places at the moment when the fist hit the body, and escaped from the certain death situation at the cost of only one arm.
The An family has been able to stand in Anya Mansion for hundreds of years, which indeed has some heritage.
But that's all.
Lu Chen closed his eyes and let his mind sink into the space between heaven and earth.
The true meaning of life and death spread in all directions like a tide, and the power of heaven and earth within a radius of dozens of miles was reflected in his perception.
He caught the faint breath that was quickly disappearing.
An Liyuan's aura was 70% weaker than when he was at his peak.
But there was a familiar smell of blood in the faint breath, which was the unique aftertaste after the An family's secret method burned the essence and blood.
Lu Chen opened his eyes and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
Like a hunter smelling blood from the wounds of his prey.
He took one step forward and suddenly disappeared from the spot.
An Liyuan was running away like crazy.
His right arm was broken at shoulder level, and blood spurted out from the break, soaking the green cloth robe into a dark brown color.
He covered the wound with his left arm and did not dare to stop for a moment. Every step he took made a circle of blood ripples in the void.
This is the An family's secret technique, the blood escape technique!
The speed he gained at the cost of burning his essence and blood consumed his few life spans with every breath.
But he couldn't care less. If he didn't run away, his life would be lost!
He was filled with regret.
If he had known that Lu Chen had already passed the limit of heaven and man when he first broke through to Grandmaster, he would never have chosen this time to take action, let alone take action himself!
The limit between heaven and man is a chasm in the realm of a grandmaster, a threshold on the road to the Martial Saint!
The vast majority of masters will never be able to touch its edge throughout their lives. When they reach the limit between heaven and man, they have to face their own life and death!
No one knows what they will encounter.
No one knew whether he could cross it.
This is why there are many masters, but those who can become martial saints are so rare!
Although the limit between heaven and man is a threshold, for warriors, it is also a qualitative change!
The realm of yin and yang adds the limitations of heaven and man, directly benchmarking the Dharma!
How can he beat someone who is at the peak of the Yin-Yang realm against someone who is in the Dharma phase realm?
He secretly resented that this little thief obviously had such strength, but he was so clumsy that he suddenly killed him when he was completely unprepared.
title_en: Chapter 738 The Backbone of Death Chapter 737 The Dharma Contains the Limitations of Heaven and Man
